title: bioinfo-kaust/hybrid-metatranscriptomics pipeline - params.longread_input schema
description: Long reads (PacBio Iso-Seq / HiFi or ONT), one row per sample. The factor column named by --condition_column is optional here.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

condition.errorMessage: Condition/group label. Required in --input when --condition_column is 'condition' (the default); may be empty in --assembly_input

reads.errorMessage: Long-read file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must be FASTA or FASTQ (.fa/.fasta/.fna/.fq/.fastq, optionally .gz)
